entries.appliesTo: any person committing sexual extortion (coercive threats involving sexual/nude images, expressly including AI-generated or AI-altered depictions)

sources.prohibition: Sec. 2, K.S.A. 21-5515(a)(2) — 'communicating by any means a threat to distribute an image, video or other recording of a person that is of a sexual nature or depicts a person in a state of nudity'
sources.coveredSubjects: Sec. 2, K.S.A. 21-5515(a)(2) — 'a threat to distribute an image, video or other recording of a person'; enhanced tier only when 'the offender is 18 years of age or older and the victim is: (i) Less than 18 years of age; or (ii) a dependent adult' (subsection (d)(1)(B))

flags: prohibition=ncii is lossy: the crime is sexual extortion (coercion/demand via threat to distribute sexual or nude images), not distribution itself, and (a)(1) also reaches demands for 'anything of value' and threats 'to injure the property or reputation of a person, commit violence against a person'; no closer enum exists in the ai-crimes vocabulary

AI hook is definitional only: subsection (h)(2) — '"image, video or other recording" means any photograph, film, video picture, digital or computer-generated image or picture… including, but not limited to, any such item that has been created, in whole or in part, altered or modified by artificial intelligence or any digital means to appear to depict or purport to depict a person, regardless of whether such person was involved in the creation of the original image, video or other recording'

criminal tier structure, no fines stated (hence no exposure block): subsection (d)(1) — sexual extortion under (a)(1)(A) or (a)(2)(A) is a 'Severity level 7, person felony', rising to 'severity level 6, person felony when the offender is 18 years of age or older and the victim is' under 18 or a dependent adult; subsection (d)(2) — under (a)(1)(B) or (a)(2)(B) a 'Severity level 4, person felony', rising to 'a severity level 3, person felony' for the same victim classes; subsection (e) — aggravated sexual extortion causing great bodily harm is 'a severity level 3, person felony'; subsection (f) — aggravated sexual extortion causing death is 'a severity level 1, person felony'
victim-conduct defense barred: subsection (g) — 'It shall not be a defense that the victim contributed to the victim's own great bodily harm or death'
act is named: 'Section 1 and the amendments made to the provisions of K.S.A. 21-5515 by this act shall be known as Caleb's Law'

entries.appliesTo: Kansas attorney general (collaborating with the state board of education and law enforcement agencies)

sources.program: New Section 1 — 'The attorney general shall prepare and provide educational materials and information concerning sexual extortion as defined in K.S.A. 21-5515, and amendments thereto.'

flags: no listed duty key fits an educational-materials/outreach mandate on a state officer; New Section 1 — 'The attorney general shall collaborate with the state board of education and law enforcement agencies to educate and notify schools, students, parents and guardians and the public'

annual reporting duty, but 'incident-reporting' does not fit (implementation report to officials, not safety incidents): 'On or before July 1, 2027, and annually thereafter, the attorney general shall file a report regarding the implementation of this section with the governor, the president and minority leader of the senate, the speaker and minority leader of the house of representatives and the state board of education'
segment binds government only; no company or school compliance duty; statutory-review carried by the first segment only per omnibus rule
